description: Answer a pending workflow decision, atomically draining it and persisting the outcome to the Novel. Use when: the server emitted a [NEED_INPUT] prompt and the caller must choose. Do NOT use when: no decision is pending — use set_badge or a state tool instead.

decision.description: The canonical decision text the workflow is waiting on.

option.description: The chosen option, or 'cancel' to abort the workflow and restore its snapshot.

name: respond_decision

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Respond to Workflow Decision
